units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣与内大臣难得会面，相见之下，回思往事，共谈多年以来彼此情况。

en.t: The Genji Grand Minister and the Inner Minister rarely had a chance to meet, and when they saw each other now, they looked back on the past and spoke together about how each of them had fared over the many years.

units.source_text: 在疏阔的期间，些微之事也要争执。

en.t: During the years when they had grown distant, they would quarrel even over trifling matters.

units.source_text: 但今天叙晤一堂，各人回忆过去种种风流韵事，便照旧撤去隔阂，畅谈今昔之事和各人近况。

en.t: But today, seated together in conversation, each recalled the many romantic episodes of the past, and as before they set aside all barriers and spoke freely of former days, present affairs, and their recent circumstances.

units.source_text: 不觉日色渐暮，互相频频劝酒。

en.t: Before they knew it, the daylight was fading, and they kept urging wine on one another.

units.source_text: 内大臣说：“今天我倘不来奉陪，便成失礼。

en.t: The Inner Minister said, "If I had failed to come and attend upon you today, it would have been discourteous.

units.source_text: 但倘知道驾到，因未奉召唤而不来，则更当受呵斥了。”

en.t: But if I had known you were here and still had not come simply because I had not been summoned, I would have deserved an even sharper rebuke."

units.source_text: 源氏答道：“我才是当受呵斥的。

en.t: Genji answered, "It is I who ought to be rebuked.

units.source_text: 我的恨事甚多呢。”

en.t: I have many grievances of my own."

units.source_text: 话中似有含蓄。

en.t: There seemed to be something implied in his words.

units.source_text: 内大臣猜想他要谈云居雁的事了，觉得麻烦，便默不作声。

en.t: The Inner Minister guessed that Genji meant to speak of Kumoi no Kari, and finding the matter troublesome, he remained silent.

units.source_text: 源氏继续说：“我们二人自昔以来，不论公事或私事，都心无隐藏，不论大事或小事，都互相闻问。

en.t: Genji continued, "From long ago, whether in public affairs or private matters, the two of us kept nothing hidden from each other, and whether the matter was great or small, we always consulted one another.

units.source_text: 好像鸟的左右两翼，协力辅佐朝廷。

en.t: Like the left and right wings of a bird, we joined our strength in service to the court.

units.source_text: 到了后来，常常发生违背当初本意之事。

en.t: Later on, however, things often happened that went against our original intentions.

units.source_text: 然而这都是内部的私事。

en.t: Yet all of those were private matters within our own circle.

units.source_text: 根本的志望并不移变。

en.t: Our fundamental purpose never changed.

units.source_text: 不知不觉之间，大家添了年龄。

en.t: Before we knew it, we had all grown older.

units.source_text: 回想往昔之事，不胜依恋之情。

en.t: When I think back on the past, I am overcome with longing for it.

units.source_text: 近年以来，难得见面。

en.t: In recent years, it has become difficult for us to meet.

units.source_text: 我等职位既高，凡事遂多限制，不能随便行动，亦是理之当然。

en.t: Since our ranks are now high, there are naturally many restraints on everything we do, and it is only reasonable that we cannot act as freely as we please.

units.source_text: 但你我谊属至亲，不妨略减威仪，随时惠然来访。

en.t: But you and I are bound by the closest friendship, so you might set ceremony aside a little and kindly visit whenever you wish.

units.source_text: 我常以不能如愿为恨也。”

en.t: I am always saddened that things cannot be as I would like."

units.source_text: 内大臣答道：“从前我等的确太亲近了。

en.t: The Inner Minister replied, "In former days, it is true that we were almost too close.

units.source_text: 甚至任情放肆，不拘礼节。

en.t: We even behaved as our feelings led us, without being bound by etiquette.

units.source_text: 常蒙开诚相待，心无隐隔。

en.t: You always treated me with open sincerity, and there was no hidden barrier between our hearts.

units.source_text: 至于辅佐朝廷，我不敢与你相并，似鸟之左右两翼。

en.t: As for serving the court, I would never dare to place myself beside you as though we were the two wings of a bird.

units.source_text: 幸蒙鼎力提拔，使我这庸碌之材，亦得身居高位，此恩无时或忘。

en.t: By good fortune I received your powerful support, so that even a mediocre man like me was able to rise to high office, and I never forget that kindness for a moment.

units.source_text: 惟年龄既积，自然万事都不能起劲耳。”

en.t: It is only that, as the years have accumulated, I naturally find it hard to summon energy for anything."

units.source_text: 他表示抱歉。

en.t: In this way, he showed his apology.
